```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(jmv)
```

All values in this report are simulated; they are not participant data.

# Method

## Data and exclusions

```{r data}
study <- read.csv(params$data)
study$framing <- factor(study$framing, levels = c("gain", "loss"))
study$source <- factor(study$source, levels = c("expert", "peer", "none"))
study$education <- factor(study$education, levels = c("secondary", "bachelor", "postgraduate"))
study$choice <- factor(study$choice, levels = c("reject", "accept"))
n_before <- nrow(study)
if (isTRUE(params$exclude_failed_checks)) study <- study[study$attention == "pass", ]
```

We excluded `r n_before - nrow(study)` participants who failed the attention check,
leaving `r nrow(study)` participants.

## Descriptives

```{r descriptives}
jmv::descriptives(data = study, vars = c("age", "trust", "education"), splitBy = "framing")
```

# Results

## Confirmatory analysis: framing and source

```{r confirmatory}
confirmatory <- jmv::ANOVA(formula = trust ~ framing * source, data = study, emMeans = ~ framing:source)
confirmatory
```

The model above is the preregistered test. Below, the same effect adjusted for age.

```{r covariate}
jmv::ancova(data = study, dep = "trust", factors = "framing", covs = "age")
```

## Change over time

```{r repeated}
jmv::anovaRM(
  data = study,
  rm = list(list(label = "time", levels = c("pre", "mid", "post"))),
  rmCells = list(
    list(measure = "pre", cell = "pre"),
    list(measure = "mid", cell = "mid"),
    list(measure = "post", cell = "post")
  ),
  bs = "framing"
)
jmv::ttestPS(data = study, pairs = list(list(i1 = "pre", i2 = "post")))
```

# Exploratory analyses

## Satisfaction

```{r satisfaction}
jmv::ttestIS(data = study, vars = "satisfaction", group = "framing")
jmv::linReg(
  data = study, dep = "satisfaction", covs = c("trust", "age"), factors = "framing",
  blocks = list(list("trust", "age"), list("framing"))
)
```

## Choice

```{r choice}
jmv::logRegBin(data = study, dep = "choice", covs = "trust", factors = "framing", blocks = list(list("trust", "framing")))
jmv::contTables(data = study, rows = "choice", cols = "source")
```

## Associations and the trust scale

```{r associations}
jmv::corrMatrix(data = study, vars = c("trust", "satisfaction", "age", "pre", "post"))
jmv::reliability(data = study, vars = c("q1", "q2", "q3", "q4", "q5", "q6"), revItems = "q4")
```
